title: Eckpunkt
metaDescription: Entdecke, was Ecken in geometrischen Figuren sind. Verstehe ihre Bedeutung anhand von Beispielen wie dem Quader.
content: {"id":"47650b99-5b7d-4729-98d9-a4fd52993ea2","type":"https://serlo.org/editor","variant":"serlo-org","domainOrigin":"serlo.org","version":2,"editorVersion":"0.22.0","dateModified":"2025-02-26T18:24:11.952Z","document":{"plugin":"article","state":{"introduction":{"plugin":"articleIntroduction","state":{"explanation":{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Eine Ecke oder ein Eckpunkt in einem Vieleck ist ein Punkt, an dem sich mehrere Seitenlinien treffen."}]}],"id":"1ac7907a-b094-4193-97ce-a2201245c77b"},"multimedia":{"plugin":"image","state":{"src":"https://assets.serlo.org/legacy/554c69de41b1c_f233a9c446c8fd603feddd880146494616033d71.png","caption":{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{}]}],"id":"adaae07f-0b13-46ab-b260-cd8bf5c82337"}},"id":"3468e6f4-209f-486d-814f-d9f125d2f85a"},"illustrating":true,"width":50},"id":"e8ea174e-af66-4828-8ceb-9f3407382178"},"content":{"plugin":"rows","state":[{"plugin":"multimedia","state":{"explanation":{"plugin":"rows","state":[{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Ebenso ist eine Ecke in einem dreidimensionalen Objekt (hier ein Quader) ein Punkt, an dem mehrere Kanten zusammentreffen."}]}],"id":"148619ee-50e1-4771-b608-db009b7a375b"}],"id":"05960ca3-9ae5-4ce2-9485-aab0ac9a3836"},"multimedia":{"plugin":"image","state":{"src":"https://assets.serlo.org/legacy/554c691801396_47553468010a1da3db04edbbf3e77071fcadcf8f.png","alt":"Eckpunkt eines Quaders","caption":{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{}]}],"id":"d2f8e3a1-db1f-4d06-83ef-cf0ada7959d5"}},"id":"54115500-1937-4117-8073-abdc308fc50e"},"illustrating":true,"width":50},"id":"feca7c73-adeb-4d4a-b195-7ce47124c059"}],"id":"fa657d78-aad8-460e-a99b-fbef60ce7f1e"},"exercises":[],"exerciseFolder":{"id":"","title":""},"relatedContent":{"articles":[],"courses":[],"videos":[]},"sources":[]},"id":"bd202695-0ccc-4d5b-ba3d-e0b5886a4c1b"}}
